statement: A redaction card that names the field holding a closed value ("replace the four repository values; every other field stays identical") was written from the field it read, not from a search for the value: the same names sat in sibling reason strings and in a location filename kept by ruling, so the card's own done-test could not go green under its own no-other-change constraint. Rule: before accepting a field-scoped redaction, search the whole file for every closed value; let the banned-term test, not the field list, define done, and put any edit beyond the card's field list in its own commit for the operator to keep or drop.

A local run of a check that counts reachability from evidence/* tags disagreed with CI because fetching '+refs/tags/evidence/*:refs/tags/evidence/*' never deletes a local tag that origin removed: a tag withdrawn by operator ruling stayed local, kept its commit reachable, and made the withheld-by-ruling errata entry report as stale (1 failure, 15 corrected locally versus 0 and 16 expected). Rule: before trusting a local run of a tag-reachability check, run the same fetch with --dry-run --prune and state any '[deleted]' ref as a local-only divergence; never report the local count as the CI count.
